An '''overrider''' was an electronic device that could be used to open locked doors. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relin Druur]] used an overrider to break into the [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']]{{'s}} [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] chamber during his [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|infiltration]] of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. He later used an overrider to break into the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|''Junker'']], after inadvertently and unknowingly [[Time travel/Legends|traveling]] through [[Time/Legends|time]] to [[41 ABY]] after being caught up in the draft of the ''Harbinger''{{'s}} failed [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump when the ship tried to flee his attack.
